cases.title: Root / issues 308 redirect to an A/B/C variant with ab_variant cookie
stepsToReproduce: Open a fresh browser profile (no cookies) and request https://amtocsoft.com/
Inspect the response status, Location header, and Set-Cookie header
cases.expectedResult: Response is 308 with Location /index-alpha, /index-beta, or /index-gamma and a Set-Cookie ab_variant=<same variant> with Path=/, Expires=next midnight UTC, SameSite=Lax

cases.title: Existing ab_variant cookie is respected on repeat visit
stepsToReproduce: Visit https://amtocsoft.com/ once and note the assigned variant from the redirect
Request https://amtocsoft.com/ again in the same browser session
cases.expectedResult: Second visit redirects to the same variant as the cookie; the variant does not re-randomize until the cookie expires

cases.title: Each variant page loads directly with shared assets
stepsToReproduce: Open /index-alpha, /index-beta, and /index-gamma directly in separate tabs
Check that styles.css, script.js, analytics.js, and favicon.ico all load with HTTP 200 on each variant
Check the browser console for errors
cases.expectedResult: All three variants render fully styled with no failed asset requests and no console errors

cases.title: Hero CTAs: Get the Starter Kit scrolls to stage 5, See It Live opens amtocbot.com
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant landing page
Click 'Get the Starter Kit' in the hero
Click 'See It Live' in the hero
cases.expectedResult: 'Get the Starter Kit' smooth-scrolls to the #stage-5 bundle section; 'See It Live' opens https://amtocbot.com in a new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener)

cases.title: Counter widgets animate from 0 to live content stats (alpha/beta)
stepsToReproduce: Open /index-alpha or /index-beta
Scroll the hero counters into view
Watch the blog/video/podcast counter values animate
Confirm the final values match https://amtocbot.com/api/content-stats fields (blogs, videos, podcasts)
cases.expectedResult: Counters animate from 0 up to the live API values; if the API is unreachable they settle on the data-counter fallback values without a console error breaking the page

cases.title: Gamma variant shows static stat tags instead of animated counters
stepsToReproduce: Open /index-gamma
Scroll through the hero
cases.expectedResult: Static stat-tag text (e.g. '250+ blog posts', '50+ videos') renders in the living-pipeline hero; no counter animation runs and no content-stats fetch errors appear

cases.title: Nav anchor links and mobile menu work
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant on desktop width; click Modules, Pricing, Licensing, Services in the top nav
Resize to mobile width (or use device emulation) and tap the hamburger menu button
Tap a nav link from the open mobile menu
cases.expectedResult: Each anchor smooth-scrolls to its section; the mobile menu toggles open/closed and closes after a link is tapped

cases.title: Module buy buttons initiate checkout via /api/checkout
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant and scroll to a module section (blueprint, blog, video, podcast, social, metrics, site)
Click the module's buy button with DevTools Network open
Observe the POST to /api/checkout with the module name in the JSON body
cases.expectedResult: A POST /api/checkout fires with {"module": "<name>"}; on success the browser is sent to the checkout URL returned by the API; on API failure the user sees an error state, not a silent dead button

cases.title: Referral code toggle, validation, and persistence
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant and scroll to the #stage-5 bundle section
Click the referral-code toggle to reveal the input row
Enter an invalid code and click Apply (or press Enter)
Enter a valid code and click Apply
Reload the page and check the referral state
cases.expectedResult: Toggle reveals/hides the input; invalid code shows an invalid status; valid code calls /api/referral/validate, shows the discount, and persists referral_code in sessionStorage so it is attached to subsequent checkout POSTs

cases.title: Reviews section loads from /api/reviews and hides when empty
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant and scroll to the reviews section
Confirm review cards render with star ratings, title, and body from GET /api/reviews
Block the /api/reviews request (DevTools request blocking) and reload
cases.expectedResult: With data, review cards render with escaped HTML (no injected markup); with an empty or failed response the section hides itself instead of rendering an empty broken block

cases.title: FAQ accordion opens one item at a time
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant and scroll to the FAQ section
Click the first question to open it
Click a second question
cases.expectedResult: Clicking a question expands its answer; opening a new question closes the previously open one so at most one FAQ item is open

cases.title: Footer legal pages load
stepsToReproduce: Open any variant and scroll to the footer
Click each of Terms of Service, License, Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Acceptable Use
cases.expectedResult: Each of /terms, /license, /privacy, /refund-policy, and /acceptable-use returns HTTP 200 with the real legal page content, not the stale SPA fallback landing
